role: Individual custodian, using the existing declared application profile

scope.calibre: Existing 150-book library profile including files, covers, organization, custom metadata and conversion settings.
scope.audacity: Editable project and audio, track/label structure, format/version boundaries, plugins and recovery. Do not silently replace AUP3 with the retained AUP4 fixture.
scope.ardour: Complete session, external media, routing/automation and plugin state; historical XML alone is not a complete archive.
scope.musescore-studio: Editable score including musical/lyric/structural meaning and export fidelity. The retained MuseScore 2.0.2 fixture is not evidence of current-version round trips.
scope.zim-wiki: Existing knowledge_notes profile with hierarchy, cross-links, tags/tasks, dates and attachments; the XML test container is not a native notebook.
scope.taskwarrior: Existing recurring-task profile with annotations, UDAs, dependencies, dates and completion history; filtered JSON and minimal import literals do not replace it.

method: Recheck hashes and independent fixture observations; read additional version-pinned source to settle explicit control/backup questions. Comprehensive medium-confidence source evidence may support a qualified E5 if it covers the relevant risks. Do not require local installation by default, but do not mistake source assertions for executed behavior.
decision_rule: Keep unresolved broad criteria Not Verified rather than Fail. Positive Longevity/Transparency require established E3/E5. Correct dependent Sovereignty/E2 claims when the reviewed evidence directly exposes an unsupported pairing. E1/E4/Locality are outside this targeted recertification unless an explicit correction is recorded.
installations: None. Do not download, build, import or execute target implementation. Source files are retained as data; only existing Python/SQLite/XML/ZIP readers run.
